snippet.title: Who Are You!? | Horror Game Awards HALLOWEEN SHOWCASE WORLD PREMIERE TRAILER 2025
snippet.description:
Who Are You!? is a sci-fi psychological horror experience, that takes place in the 80's around the disappearance of Amanda, Ray's Wife, 20 years in the past, revolving around what apparently could be an alien abduction. For this project we are working with a psychologist advisor, to recreate all the real aspects of depression under these circumstances, and a team of researchers in the ufology field, so we can introduce the real aspects of several alien abduction's investigations, and how the family feels about it, into the story.

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646450/Who_Are_You/

#thehorrorgameawards #HorrorGamesShowcase
---
The Horror Game Awards started towards the end of 2022 as a Horror Game of the Year Award set up by two die hard horror game fans. Fourteen content creators made up that year’s jury. It was such a success that in 2023 the jury doubled in size and the awards expanded their scope.

The aim of the awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
